verdict.rationale: Adyen Issuing documents API-driven card operations: issuing cards by creating paymentInstrument resources, updating cards via /paymentInstruments/{id}, and raising disputes via the Raise disputes API. It also offers relayed authorisation webhooks and a range of webhook types, with an llms.txt available for its docs. However, some setup is Customer Area-only (relayed authorisation configuration, dispute zip uploads), and probes found no machine-readable OpenAPI spec at the candidate paths. missing for 10: an evidenced API reference/OpenAPI spec, API parity for configuration currently done in the Customer Area, independent or hands-on corroboration.
